fields.name: key
fields.label: Lookup Key
fields.description: Stable identifier. Generic concepts: needle-dc27. Brand-scoped: juki-bobbin. Auto-generated by npm run scan-parts.

fields.name: type
fields.label: Concept Type
fields.description: 'generic' = industry-standard part, shared across brands (Needle DC×27, 608ZZ Bearing). 'brand-scoped' = same physical part but with brand-specific geometry.

fields.name: label
fields.label: Concept Display Name
fields.description: Human-readable concept (e.g. 'Needle (DC×27 system)', 'Bobbin (assembly with case)').

fields.name: brand
fields.label: Brand (null for generic concepts)
fields.description: Brand for brand-scoped concepts. Empty for generic concepts that share across all brands.

fields.name: machines
fields.label: Used In Machines
fields.description: Slugs of every machine file in src/content/machines/ that contains this part.

fields.name: occurrences
fields.label: Total Occurrences
fields.description: How many part rows across all machines match this concept.

fields.name: hasImage
fields.label: Image Already Uploaded?
fields.description: True when a matching entry exists in src/content/parts-library/. Auto-checked by npm run scan-parts.

fields.name: sampleNames
fields.label: Sample Part Names
fields.description: Up to 4 real partName strings from the matched rows — useful for verifying the concept matches the right thing.

fields.name: key
fields.label: Part Key (auto-generated from filename)
fields.description: Filename slug. Format: <brand>-<partId-or-slug>. Example: juki-m-027 or juki-thrust-collar. Auto-generated — usually you don't need to edit this.

fields.name: brand
fields.label: Brand
fields.description: Manufacturer brand. Example: JUKI, Brother, Kansai Special.

fields.name: partId
fields.label: Official Component ID
fields.description: As printed in the parts catalog. Example: M-027, U-178. Leave empty if the part has no Component ID.

fields.name: partName
fields.label: Canonical Part Name
fields.description: The standard name used across all machines that share this part. Example: Crank, Needle Bar, Presser Foot.

fields.name: image
fields.label: Part Image
fields.description: Exploded-view or product photo. PNG / JPG / JPEG / WebP. One image per part. This is the image shown when users click a part name on any machine page.

fields.name: notes
fields.label: Notes (optional)
fields.description: Any caveats — e.g. 'Used in MO-6800D and MO-6814D variants only' or 'Same physical part as B-118, just renumbered'.

fields.name: componentIds
fields.label: Component IDs (referenced in this principle)
fields.description: List of part IDs from the parts list that are involved in this principle.

fields.name: category
fields.label: Parts Category (catalog group)
fields.description: Catalog group such as Drive & Transmission, Cutting Assembly, Motor & Electrical, Fasteners & Hardware, etc.

fields.name: qty
fields.label: Quantity per machine
fields.description: As printed in the parts catalog (e.g. 1, 2, 4, as needed).

fields.name: material
fields.label: Material
fields.description: Material as listed in catalog (e.g. High Speed Steel, Cast Iron). Empty if not listed.

fields.name: verified
fields.label: Verification flag
fields.description: ✅ = 2+ official sources · ⚠️ = 1 official source · ❌ = sources conflict · 📋 = manual only · 🔴 = unverified

fields.name: source
fields.label: Source URL
fields.description: URL of the official catalog/manual page that documents this part.

fields.name: flag
fields.label: Source flag (optional)
fields.description: Leave blank for entries in the official manual. Use '⚠️ Field Reported' for known field issues not in the manual.

fields.name: partsMeta
fields.label: Parts Catalog Meta
fields.description: Provenance of the parts list. Required for new machines researched via the /research skill.

description.value: References another document, used as a foreign key
